shoutout.name: Mei Chen
shoutout.quote: Mei turned up to every single over 60s session this term, brought a friend along, and deadlifted her bodyweight on Tuesday. That's what Tribe looks like.

challenge.title: Bring a mate to a session
challenge.body: Friends train free this week. Post a photo together on the wall for a bonus +50 Tribe Points each.

posts.author: Jermaine
posts.body: New month, new board. Reminder of what the leaderboard actually rewards: turning up. Four sessions a week at your pace beats one hero session. Set a check-in goal with your coach this week and let's go.

posts.author: Mei Chen
posts.body: Deadlifted my bodyweight today at 63 years old. Eighteen months ago I couldn't get off the floor without a hand. Thank you Rosely and the 7.45 crew for never letting me sit one out.

posts.author: Aisha Rahman
posts.body: First unassisted pull-up. Took eleven months. Worth every rep.

posts.author: Tom Baxter
posts.body: Anyone doing the 5:30am Thursday semi-private? Looking for a regular training partner for the next block.

posts.author: Shiv
posts.body: Women's strength block starts Monday 6:15. Bring a mate — friends train free this week. No experience needed, just turn up.

posts.author: Priya Nair
posts.body: Shoutout to Hannah for talking me through my first sled push on Tuesday. Didn't die. Might even go back.

posts.author: Ben Carter
posts.body: FIFO swing done, straight back into the 4:30 sessions. Seven check-ins this week and I'm somehow still third. Zoe, I'm coming for you.

posts.author: Rosely
posts.body: Over 60s crew: 100% attendance this term. Every single session. That's the Tribe standard right there.
